models.reclaim_30m: First 15m close back inside the first 30m range following a close outside; stop 0.5 points beyond reclaim candle, target 2R, 30m holding period.
models.breakout_90m: First 15m close outside the first 30m range; stop 0.5 points beyond opposite opening-range edge, target 2R, 90m holding period.
models.opening_bias: At 10:00 NY, first 30m change predicts remaining-session close relative to 10:00 close; compare always-up at the same times.

entry: First raw-bar open at or after the decision plus declared scenario latency; no new candidate after a missed first event.
intrabar_ambiguity: Report lower and upper bounds when both target and stop hit in one raw bar; lower bound governs decisions.
gaps: Stop gap exits at opening price; favorable gap target exits capped at target. No filling missing bars.
session: Actual XNYS regular session including early closes and DST; missing complete grids excluded with reason.
splits: Before 2026-09-14 versus on/after 2026-09-14, both exploratory and previously used.
screen: A candidate remains research-only. Suspend this parameterization if net lower bound at 1 point cost is nonpositive in either time block under the zero-delay scenario. Positive survivors require unused prospective data, implementable instruments and timely source verification.
selection: No parameter search, threshold tuning, combination of methods or changes to frozen model.
bootstrap: 1000 session resamples, deterministic seed 711, 95% interval for total lower-bound points at cost 1; descriptive on consumed data.
